The '''Ixtlar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Ixtlar sector/Legends|Ixtlar sector]] near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] the planet fell to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after the [[Battle of Ixtlar (Clone Wars)|Battle of Ixtlar]]. Later the system fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] until their withdrawal from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].
